description: Pivot WAKA from inspiration capture into an ambition mirror powered by a personal context graph. Keep the post-it Top of Mind metaphor, aggressively migrate naming, keep graph inspection internal, and add a first self-improving loop through user feedback.

userStories.title: Document domain rename map and migration strategy
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a concrete domain migration plan so every later Ralph iteration uses signal/context/top-of-mind language consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a docs plan that maps existing inspiration, meaning, and WOW concepts to signal, context graph, and top-of-mind concepts
Define which old tables/routes/components are renamed, wrapped, or left internal
State that admin graph inspection remains internal and should not become the primary user-facing graph UI
Include a phased compatibility note for existing data and tests
Run a markdown/file sanity check by reviewing the new doc

userStories.title: Introduce signal domain types without changing behavior
userStories.description: As a developer, I need signal-oriented API and shared types so the new product vocabulary can land before destructive route/schema migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Add signal-facing TypeScript types that map to the current inspiration persistence shape
Expose score names for resonance, recurrence, agency, identity signal, and decision relevance even if some initially derive from existing score fields
Keep existing inspiration routes working
Add targeted API or web tests proving existing capture/list behavior still works through the new type layer
Run relevant API and web typechecks

userStories.title: Add context graph node categories
userStories.description: As a developer, I need typed context graph nodes so graph output can represent ambition-relevant structure instead of generic meaning only.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or migrate graph node type support for theme, value, person, environment, aesthetic, tension, project, open_question, and hypothesis
Preserve existing meaning graph data through a deterministic default type where needed
Update graph writer types and tests to understand the allowed node categories
Keep the admin graph route internal and functional
Run API typecheck and targeted graph writer/admin graph tests

userStories.title: Rename meaning packet concept to signal packet in code paths
userStories.description: As a developer, I need per-signal interpretation logic to use signal packet naming so future model prompts focus on why a signal matters to the user's ambitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Introduce signal packet naming in library/API code while preserving or migrating existing meaning packet storage
Update prompts or deterministic packet text headers away from generic meaning language where tests allow
Keep old data readable
Update tests that assert packet creation or packet text
Run API typecheck and targeted packet tests

userStories.title: Create Top of Mind note model from WOW moments
userStories.description: As a user, I want graph-backed post-it reflections to feel provisional and replaceable rather than permanent WOW artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Introduce top-of-mind note types and serializers mapped from or migrated from current WOW moment persistence
Support note types pattern, tension, question, hypothesis, and action
Expose confidence, status, related signal ids, and related context node ids where available
Keep existing WOW routes working until UI route migration is complete
Run API typecheck and targeted WOW/top-of-mind tests

userStories.title: Add top-of-mind API route
userStories.description: As the web app, I need a `/api/top-of-mind` route that returns the current post-it reflection surface without exposing internal graph admin APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Add authenticated `/api/top-of-mind` list/detail endpoints or an equivalent route matching existing API style
Return active top-of-mind notes with evidence previews and related signal references
Do not expose raw admin graph internals
Add route tests for tenant scoping and serialization
Run API typecheck and targeted route tests

userStories.title: Add user feedback persistence for graph-backed notes
userStories.description: As a user, I want to validate or correct generated notes so WAKA can improve its personal context graph over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Add feedback persistence for targets signal, context_node, top_of_mind_note, and hypothesis
Support feedback values true, partly, not_true, important, and not_important
Support optional emotion labels admire, envy, want, fear, curious, and aesthetic_only
Add authenticated feedback create/list API behavior with tenant scoping
Run migration checks, API typecheck, and targeted feedback tests

userStories.title: Apply feedback to context graph weights
userStories.description: As WAKA, I need user validation to strengthen, weaken, or qualify graph claims so the reflection loop genuinely improves.
acceptanceCriteria: Add deterministic feedback application logic that updates top-of-mind note status and related context node confidence or weight
True/important feedback strengthens related claims; not_true/not_important weakens or marks stale; partly preserves the note and asks for correction when available
Store provenance that the update came from user feedback
Add unit tests for each feedback value
Run API typecheck and targeted feedback/graph tests

userStories.title: Refresh Top of Mind notes from context graph
userStories.description: As WAKA, I need a bounded job that regenerates provisional post-it notes from recent, recurring, high-agency, or unresolved graph patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a refresh job or service that selects candidate context nodes and evidence to produce active top-of-mind notes
Prioritize recurrence, agency, unresolved tensions, and recent evidence
Avoid duplicating active notes for the same underlying graph claim
Add deterministic tests for ranking and deduplication
Run API typecheck and targeted top-of-mind refresh tests

userStories.title: Update home surface to Top of Mind first
userStories.description: As a returning user, I want the home page to foreground provisional Top of Mind post-its while keeping capture one click away.
acceptanceCriteria: Show capture-first behavior for low-data users and top-of-mind-first behavior when enough signals exist
Rename visible WOW/inspiration language toward top-of-mind, signal, resonance, and reflection language
Keep the existing post-it visual metaphor
Add or update component tests for low-data and returning-user states
Run web typecheck, targeted tests, and browser verification

userStories.title: Add evidence drawer for Top of Mind notes
userStories.description: As a user, I need to inspect why WAKA believes a reflection so generated notes feel trustworthy instead of like AI fortune-telling.
acceptanceCriteria: Each top-of-mind note can reveal evidence signals and related context nodes
Evidence copy is concise and avoids exposing internal admin graph fields
The drawer or panel works on mobile and desktop without overlapping content
Add component tests for evidence rendering and empty evidence states
Run web typecheck, targeted tests, and browser verification

userStories.title: Add feedback controls to Top of Mind notes
userStories.description: As a user, I want lightweight controls like true, partly, not true, important, and not important so I can train WAKA without organizing notes manually.
acceptanceCriteria: Add compact feedback controls to each active top-of-mind note
Submitting feedback updates note state optimistically and persists through the API
Support optional correction text without forcing the user to write
Add web tests for submit success and failure states
Run web typecheck, targeted tests, and browser verification

userStories.title: Rename capture UI toward signal and resonance
userStories.description: As a user, I want capture copy that matches the ambition mirror direction without making the product feel heavy or permanent.
acceptanceCriteria: Update visible capture copy from inspiration/WOW framing toward signal, resonance, and what hit
Keep input friction low and manual capture fast
Do not require tagging or structured journaling
Update affected tests and snapshots
Run web typecheck, targeted tests, and browser verification

userStories.title: Abstract model provider from Gemini-specific names
userStories.description: As a developer, I need model calls abstracted so signal interpretation, context graph updates, and top-of-mind generation are not hardwired to Gemini naming.
acceptanceCriteria: Introduce a model provider interface for classification, packet generation, graph writing, and note generation
Keep Gemini as the current implementation
Avoid leaking provider-specific names into product-domain services
Update tests/mocks around the interface
Run API typecheck and targeted model pipeline tests

userStories.title: Add first decision memo scaffold for what to build
userStories.description: As a user, I want WAKA to turn my context graph into a lightweight decision memo for what to build next.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a backend or frontend scaffold for a what-to-build decision memo using existing context graph and top-of-mind evidence
Memo includes what the user seems drawn to, strongest evidence, tensions, and one testable next action
Keep this behind an internal or low-prominence route if the rest of the product is not ready
Add targeted tests for memo assembly with fixture graph data
Run relevant typechecks and tests

userStories.title: Final terminology cleanup and compatibility audit
userStories.description: As a developer, I need old inspiration/WOW/meaning vocabulary either intentionally internal, migrated, or documented before the Ralph run is considered complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit remaining user-facing inspiration, WOW, and meaning strings
Rename user-facing vocabulary where appropriate and document intentional internal leftovers
Ensure existing routes kept for compatibility are clearly marked
Run API and web typechecks plus the highest-value targeted regression tests
Update progress.txt Codebase Patterns with final naming conventions
